info.title: Driftglass API
info.description: Personal intelligence for standing questions: chosen sources become developing Stories, current cited answers, connected memory, decisions, forecasts, Intelligence Packs, and one workspace per Mission.

count.description: Items accepted for Queue delivery, not a final ingested count.

status.description: queued means collection is complete but durable per-item ingestion is still pending; terminal success/partial/failed appears in source-run history.

finished_at.description: Null while queued ingestion remains nonterminal.

ingest_failed_attempts.description: Highest Queue retry count observed for the run; the initial delivery is zero retries.

IngestDeadLetterSummary.description: Content-free owner view of a D1 or emergency private-R2 recovery incident. The bounded private recovery body is never returned.

storage.description: Present only for the emergency private-R2 fallback.

InboxReceiptSummary.description: Owner-visible inbound Email receipt. Queue acceptance is not a substitute for polling the resulting Story as the durable-ingestion proof.

metadata_json.description: Bounded JSON metadata including attachment descriptors; attachment bodies are never stored.

id.description: Required for a Story or Mission share; omit for a briefing.

reviewedRunId.description: Optional reviewed reasoning run prepared for the same share scope.

get.summary: List owner actions across Mission cadence, expected events, research approvals, and degraded sources

post.summary: Search the optional semantic retrieval projection
post.description: Runs Cloudflare AI Search hybrid vector and keyword retrieval with reranking and optional record-kind filtering. Returns AI_SEARCH_DISABLED until the owner explicitly runs setup.

409.description: AI_SEARCH_DISABLED or AI_SEARCH_NOT_CONFIGURED; setup is required and no instance is created by this read

post.summary: Explicitly enable the optional AI Search retrieval projection
post.description: The sole creation and enablement path. Creates or reconnects the Driftglass AI Search instance and persists owner opt-in; synchronization remains a separate explicit operation.

201.description: AI Search is enabled and its named instance is configured

get.summary: Get optional AI Search retrieval status
get.description: Returns binding availability, persisted owner enablement, instance configuration, indexing, and last-sync state as separate fields. This read never creates or enables an instance.

post.summary: Synchronize optional AI Search documents from canonical Driftglass state
post.description: Uploads changed Story, Mission, and briefing documents and deletes stale indexed items after explicit setup. Returns AI_SEARCH_DISABLED without scheduling work when setup has not run.

wait.description: Wait for the final AI Search indexing operation and return its result instead of scheduling the sync.

202.description: Enabled synchronization was accepted for background execution

409.description: AI_SEARCH_DISABLED or AI_SEARCH_NOT_CONFIGURED; explicit setup is required

get.summary: List exhausted ingest messages requiring owner recovery
get.description: Returns content-free operational metadata only across the normal D1 store and emergency private-R2 fallback. Bounded recovery bodies remain server-side.

post.summary: Dismiss one exhausted ingest message
post.description: Marks a D1 record ignored and clears its recovery body. An emergency private-R2 incident is first integrity-checked and materialized through normal D1 tracked-run and Email-failure accounting; R2 deletion follows the permanent content-free ignored audit.

post.summary: Retry one exhausted ingest message
post.description: Integrity-checks and requeues the stored body through durability preflight and Queue budget reservation. Emergency R2 incidents first materialize through normal D1 tracked-run and Email-failure accounting; the private body is cleared only after send succeeds, and R2 deletion follows the permanent content-free D1 audit.

200.description: A previously committed emergency-R2 retry was cleaned up without another Queue send

202.description: Dead letter accepted for Queue redelivery
